subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt/repair the open fork cleanup PR, replace it with a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR, or reject the Google Chat NO_REPLY placeholder cleanup?
rationale: Current main still has the source-level bug, but the issue already has an open closing PR from a fork, so ClawSweeper should not queue duplicate implementation work without a human path choice.

options.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 as the candidate if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement that preserves the same Google Chat lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Reject the cleanup
options.body: Close the candidate and this issue only if maintainers decide the message placeholder behavior is acceptable or unsupported for reaction-only turns.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 as the candidate if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement that preserves the same Google Chat lifecycle boundary.
